classes.dependent_projection: may cascade when the row has no independent historical meaning
classes.durable_history: must survive routine parent lifecycle changes unless an explicit retention policy permits purge
classes.optional_reference: may set null when the referenced object is optional and loss of the link preserves meaning
classes.protected_reference: restrict hard deletion while dependent meaning exists
classes.compatibility_shortcut: lifecycle follows its authoritative source and may not become a second deletion authority

recordings.work_id.reason: recording may remain meaningful without the optional single-work shortcut; lossless relationships remain elsewhere

release_tracks.release_id.reason: track position is owned by its release

release_tracks.recording_id.reason: a release track must not silently lose the referenced canonical recording

recording_versions.recording_id.reason: current schema treats version lifecycle as dependent; canonical hard-delete policy still needs explicit owner confirmation

external_identifiers.metadata_source_id.reason: identifier provenance degradation on hard source deletion must be deliberate

metadata_assertions.metadata_source_id.reason: assertion evidence must retain its source identity

metadata_conflicts.left_assertion_id.reason: conflict history currently disappears with assertion hard deletion; retention semantics must be explicit before real editorial history

metadata_conflicts.right_assertion_id.reason: same retention concern as left assertion

entity_matches.provider_entity_id.reason: identity-match evidence may be needed after provider-entity lifecycle changes

canonical_admission_decisions.metadata_a.reason: editorial decision/audit history should not be silently removed by assertion hard deletion; requires explicit retention decision before data-bearing transition

provider_destinations.provider_id.reason: destination evidence is provider-owned and does not define canonical identity

unresolved_owner_decisions: canonical hard-delete policy versus soft-delete-only operational practice
metadata conflict retention after assertion purge
canonical admission decision retention after assertion purge
whether external identifier source deletion may intentionally lose metadata_source_id
rule: No reviewed delete action may be changed by a future stage without owning lifecycle authority, compatibility classification and migration/recovery evidence.
